condition_comparison.source_atom: 設計⇔実装⇔テストの整合を機械強制
condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: L2-001 specifies canonical L1-L12 V-pairs and distinguishes L2/L11 from L3/L10; L2-004 derives affected design/test and re-verification scope; L2-005 derives validation obligations and evidence conditions from ticket relation, change kind, layer, and risk, independent of language/tool/implementation.
condition_comparison.residual: No BR-01-specific acceptance oracle proves end-to-end design/implementation/test consistency or a complete trace for every project. Pair-level obligations are broader contracts, not BR-01 successor or closure.

condition_comparison.source_atom: AI 委譲しても回帰が壊れず
condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: Unagreed or unverified work cannot advance; right-side integration is checked against paired design; only meaning-preserving changes are refactored and semantic changes backflow; changed conditions require re-verification; needed checks/oracle/expected failure/evidence are derived before PR.
condition_comparison.residual: The source has no numeric regression threshold, fixture set, failure/output schema, or BR-01-specific regression oracle. Fixed pair conditions do not establish zero regression under AI delegation or implementation behavior.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: L2-001 composes planning, requirements, L2.5, requirement, design, implementation, and verification on current canonical L1-L12 pairs; L0 is kept as an external charter anchor, not a layer in the canonical pairs. L2-003 separates start/freeze/backflow/reopen/complete and artifact states; L11 distinguishes completion and release conditions.
condition_comparison.residual: The literal cardinality “1 project” and a single-project end-to-end acceptance result are not stated as an identity-specific oracle. Legacy L0-L14 is intentionally not transferred as current numbering; current pair contract is L1-L12 with L0 external.

condition_comparison.retained_or_rederived: These are source trace labels; paired requirements cover canonical layer/pair composition, lifecycle gates, change impact, and verification obligations.
